what_this_is: Every setting the tool reads from the person's own settings file, with what it means and its type. The tool carries no values: the settings are the person's data (their microphone, room, loudness target and voice), read at run time from a path they give or from their records. A run with a key missing stops and names it.

handle_seconds.meaning: Seconds of audio kept before a span's from and after its to, so a later edit can fade or trim without cutting a word.

snr_db_min.meaning: Signal to noise (speech level over the noise floor read from the pauses) under which a span is graded for noise.

snr_db_hard_min.meaning: Signal to noise under which noise is a hard fault: if the remaster still lands here the span is graded clone.

hum_prominence_db_max.meaning: How far a mains hum line may stand above its neighbours in the pauses.

hum_applies_when_snr_below.meaning: A hum counts as a fault only when the signal to noise is under this.

room_tail_db_max.meaning: Level of the room's tail 80 to 250 ms after a word that precedes a pause, against the word's last 100 ms; above this the room is a hard fault.

room_tail_min_samples.meaning: How many words with a following pause the room-tail reading needs before it counts.

rumble_share_max.meaning: Share of the noise below 120 Hz (wind, handling) above which it is a fault, 0 to 1.

rumble_applies_when_noise_floor_above_db.meaning: Rumble counts only when the noise floor is louder than this level (dBFS).

clip_fraction_max.meaning: Share of samples at full scale above which the span is clipped, a hard fault.

true_peak_db_max.meaning: True peak (dB) above which the span is graded for clipping.

lufs_min.meaning: Quietest acceptable integrated loudness of a span (LUFS).

lufs_max.meaning: Loudest acceptable integrated loudness of a span (LUFS).

words_uncertain_errors.meaning: Word errors between a read of the untouched cut and the span's text from which the text itself is in doubt.

garbled_errors.meaning: Word errors of the best remaster candidate (against both reads) from which the remaster is judged garbled and the span goes to clone.

speaker_similarity_min.meaning: Cosine similarity of voice embeddings between a span and the clone reference at or above which the span is accepted as the reference speaker. Set it from clips known to be the speaker.

remaster_target_lufs.meaning: Loudness a remastered or cloned span is finished to (LUFS).

hum_notch_q.meaning: Q of the notch put on a hum and its first two harmonics.

denoise_reduction_db.meaning: Noise reduction of the ffmpeg afftdn candidate (dB).

denoise_soft_limit_db.meaning: The most the soft DeepFilterNet candidate may remove (dB), for noise that overlaps the voice.

duck_db.meaning: How far the pauses are lowered when the room was the fault (dB, negative).

deess_frequency.meaning: De-esser frequency, 0 to 1 of the Nyquist frequency.

clone_phrase_stretch_max.meaning: Most a cloned phrase may be sped up or slowed to fit the time the original phrase took, as a fraction (0.2 is 20 %).

reference_lufs_min.meaning: Quietest window accepted as a clone reference (LUFS).

reference_lufs_max.meaning: Loudest window accepted as a clone reference (LUFS).

read_model.meaning: The speech-to-text model whisper-style reads are made with through mlx-whisper (a model name or path). Used by the remaster choice, the clone check and the read-back.

clone_model.meaning: The voice-cloning text-to-speech model the clone stage loads through mlx-audio (a model name or path that takes a reference recording). Used only by clone_speech.py.

language.meaning: Language of the speech, as whisper names it (for example en).

spoken_forms.meaning: Spoken forms a read and the text may spell differently, as {"form": "words it counts as"}; may be empty.
